about: Malformed runtime script lists and the reason each reader gives. Each case edits the committed scripts/runtime-scripts.json by JSON pointer (set, then remove). scripts/runtime-scripts.mjs (runtimeScriptsFailure) and the Rust validator (runtime_inline_scripts) must both accept a case whose error is null and refuse every other case with exactly its error.
